records.text: Jake Hoffman accused Katie Hobbs of repeatedly acting in a petty and partisan manner and said she vetoed about nine of his bills the prior year, once using a committee acronym as her stated reason.
records.speaker: Jake Hoffman

appearances.snippet: Now, the reality is that Katie Hobbs has repeatedly been petty and partisan in everything that she's done, whether it be her nominees that she appoints to run the state agencies or her veto track record. In fact, just last year, she vetoed about nine of my bills. I chaired the nominations committee, and she used the acronym of the committee as her reason for the veto. verification.notes: The Fox interview confirms Hoffman made the accusation and cited vetoes plus a committee-acronym explanation. Independent Arizona reporting confirms Hobbs vetoed 12 Hoffman-sponsored measures in 2025 and used the phrase Detrimental, Ineffective, Nonsensical, and Objectionable, an apparent DINO reference. The core is supported, but the stated count of about nine is imprecise against the reported total of 12.
